objectives.title: Representative Appointment
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding the formal designation of an EU representative.
criteria: Provisions designating a representative located in the European Union.
Writings requiring the representative designation in written form.
Clauses specifying representative establishment in a Member State of affected data subjects.

objectives.title: Representative Communication Authority
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding the authority of the representative to be addressed on data protection compliance matters.
criteria: Provisions authorizing the representative to receive communications from supervisory authorities.
Provisions authorizing the representative to receive inquiries from data subjects.
Provisions mandating that the representative may be addressed instead of, or in addition to, the controller or processor.

objectives.title: Representative Legal Standing
objectives.description: The contract contains writings clarifying that designating a representative does not shield the controller or processor from direct legal action.
criteria: Clauses confirming that designating a representative does not preclude legal actions against the controller directly.
Clauses confirming that designating a representative does not preclude legal actions against the processor directly.

objectives.title: Representative Designation Exemption Grounds
objectives.description: The contract contains writings addressing the statutory grounds under which the obligation to designate an EU representative does not apply.
criteria: Provisions citing occasional processing as grounds for exemption from designating a representative.
Provisions citing the absence of large-scale special-category or criminal-conviction data processing as grounds for exemption.
Provisions citing a low risk to data subjects' rights and freedoms, assessed by the nature, context, scope and purposes of processing, as grounds for exemption.
Provisions citing the entity's status as a public authority or body as grounds for exemption from designating a representative.
